description: A SIGN clause on a GROUP item that applies to a signed numeric subordinate whose usage is not DISPLAY (kb/Work PB1319). COBOL-85 required 'The numeric data description entries to which the SIGN clause applies must be described as USAGE IS DISPLAY'; the 2023 text of 13.18.52.3 SR2 restricts only 'an elementary item for which the SIGN clause is specified', and 13.18.52.4 GR1 applies a group's clause to a binary or packed item without effect (CONFORMANCE.md D-SIGN1). THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED, exactly as sign-group-unsigned-subordinates-2002's (VCR row 7.40). A subordinate that writes its own SIGN clause is the subject of that clause (GR2/GR3), so the group's clause does not apply to it or to anything below it. Gated in ONE place, CheckSignClausesPass.
display: a group SIGN clause applying to a signed numeric item whose usage is not DISPLAY
citation: ISO §2023:13.18.52.3 SR2 (2023 text); ANSI X3.23-1985 SIGN clause syntax rule (vendor transcriptions); VCR row 7.40 (derived 2002 edge)
vcr: VCR row 7.40 (85->2002: a group SIGN clause may cover a signed numeric item of another usage)
